dragon_bell.desc: Brass call bell. Click it: it rings, and an old goat-dragon rises behind the window

dragon_peek.desc: Old white goat-dragon (a goat head and shaggy white fur, with dragon scales, fangs, spurs, frills and spines), drawn by hand, who rises behind the bell window when the bell rings: opens its amber eye (the third eyelid slides back), looks at the bell, leans in and puts its head over the sill into the room, breathes out, blinks, parts its jaws with a sigh, leans back out and sinks down (63 frames); rest: a loop of it with its head in over the sill, breathing and blinking (37 frames). Play it together with dragon_peek_front

dragon_peek_front.desc: The goat-dragon's head where it leans in over the sill: draw it after the room shell, with the same anims and timing as dragon_peek (it is empty while the goat is outside the window). Casts a soft shadow on the wall
